rationale: C06 plausibly supplied a concrete drafting template. It concerns an atomic-cooperation agreement for mutual-defense purposes under the same statute and uses highly distinctive language reproduced in the child, including the partner's “substantial and material contributions,” the determination that performance “will promote and will not constitute an unreasonable risk to the common defense and security,” approval of the agreement, and authorization for the Secretary of State to execute it. C13 contains substantially the same machinery but is earlier and somewhat less proximate in wording and subject. C05 shares only the atomic-energy topic and does not contain the operative legal sequence.

shared_material.child_excerpt: the United Kingdom is participating with the United States in international arrangements pursuant to which it is making Substantial and material contributions to the mutual defense and security
shared_material.parent_excerpt: Australia, so long as Australia pursuant to an international arrangement continues to make substantial and material contributions to the mutual defense effort
shared_material.explanation: Distinctive eligibility predicate for defense-related atomic cooperation, adapted from Australia to the United Kingdom.

shared_material.child_excerpt: Determine that the performance of this Agreement will promote and will not constitute an unreasonable risk to the common defense and security of the United States
shared_material.parent_excerpt: I hereby determine that the performance of this proposed agreement will promote and will not constitute an unreasonable risk to the common defense and security
shared_material.explanation: Near-verbatim statutory determination central to approving the agreement.

shared_material.child_excerpt: Approve the proposed Agreement for Cooperation; and ... Authorize the execution of the proposed Agreement for the Government of the United States by the Secretary of State
shared_material.parent_excerpt: approve this agreement. In addition, I hereby authorize ... the Secretary of State to execute the proposed agreement
shared_material.explanation: Parallel operative sequence: presidential approval followed by authorization of execution by the Secretary of State.
